subject.title: fix(agents): drop stale internal orphan prompts

question: Should this narrow internal-orphan drop rule proceed after real embedded-agent proof, or should maintainers prefer the broader repair strategy in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90759?
rationale: The diff changes session-state prompt repair semantics, and tests do not prove that all six internal handoff sources are safe to drop in a real embedded-agent run.

options.title: Require proof and coordinate strategy
options.body: Keep this PR blocked until redacted runtime evidence proves the drop/preserve cases and maintainers decide how it relates to the broader candidate PR.

options.title: Accept the narrow rule
options.body: Proceed only if maintainers already have equivalent private proof and explicitly accept dropping all six internal handoff sources when a fresh prompt exists.

options.title: Prefer the broader candidate
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90759 as the canonical landing path and close this PR once that direction is confirmed.

recommendation.title: Require proof and coordinate strategy
recommendation.body: Keep this PR blocked until redacted runtime evidence proves the drop/preserve cases and maintainers decide how it relates to the broader candidate PR.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is closest to the queued-user preservation invariant introduced in the merged active-turn repair PR.
